messages:
olivia: FYI — we've got a handful of support tickets where customers can see org-level quota/usage pages for other orgs. Started ~09:10. Suspect last week's RBAC tidy-up.
sec-bot: alert: role-policy-change detected: PR #4823 merged by samir at 2024-06-03T08:07:22Z (sha: abc123)
zach: Can you paste an example ticket or screenshot?
olivia: https://support.redwood/internal/INC-4123 (redacted) — screenshot shows Billing -> Usage with other org IDs listed.
maya: I traced a deploy tied to that PR — samir added a small permission tweak that looks like it widened scope. snippet from the role file:
```
- role: support_agent
  permissions:
    - billing:read
    - billing:usage:read   # accidentally grants org-scoped view when resource omitted
```
samir: That was my change — I added billing:usage:read to let support inspect customer usage during troubleshooting. I intended it to be scoped per-org, but the policy parser treats that permission as global without an explicit resource selector. My mistake.
zach: Can we pull audit logs to see which org_ids were accessed and by whom? Also flag: does KMS logging mask org identifiers? might complicate forensics.
olivia: Quick check: console.view audit events show many requests between 08:15-08:25 with org_id="*" in the policy decision. KMS-only logs just have ciphertext blobs; we can correlate via request_id in access logs.
sec-bot: note: revert branch created: revert/rbac-billing-4823 by deploy-bot
samir: I'll open a PR to revert the permission and add a scoped variant. Also adding tests to enforce resource selectors for billing perms.
deploy-bot: deploy: rollback revert/rbac-billing-4823 -> production succeeded at 2024-06-03T08:48:12Z :white_check_mark:
maya: Post-rollback actions: add unit test ensuring `billing:usage:read` fails without `resource: org/<id>`; add a migration to tighten legacy roles; add a regression alert on role diffs touching admin/billing scopes.
samir: Will do. Also propose we require two approvers for any policy changes touching billing or cost/usage surfaces.
olivia: +1. I'll draft an incident timeline for legal/support and assemble affected org list. cc: @legal.
zach: :thumbsup: Once PRs land, let's monitor Support queue and close tickets if resolved. Also add an automated audit entry whenever role perms are changed that summarizes scope effects.
